warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Model/editor quality-v2 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0081; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Quality-v2 remediation rechecked learner-facing English, removed known weak/teacher-directive patterns where present, and kept the bounded target pragmatically licensed by its prompt.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian translations preserve the emotional/state sense of feel without adding another target.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One target verb is contrasted across two familiar states.

distractorQuality.evidence: Placeholder/generic distractors were removed where present; choices use contrastive alternatives with distinct teaching feedback.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: The scene and adjacent turns were checked again so character prompts function as dialogue rather than teacher commands.

difficultyFit.evidence: Both utterances are short, concrete and early-A1 appropriate.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: The stable frame supports retrieval while the adjective changes.

transferQuality.evidence: The learner transfers feel from good to tired.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, dialogue and activities support one bounded outcome.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed; boredom, perceived difficulty and retention remain unverified.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
